title: Healthpeak Properties Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Increases Full Year 2026 Earnings Guidance
summary: Healthpeak Properties, Inc. (NYSE: DOC) ("Healthpeak"), a leading owner, operator, and developer of real estate for healthcare discovery and delivery, today announced results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
